mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API( shop_type, shop_id, sub_store, settlement_type, settlement_date, total_sale, service_fee, settlement_target_amount, settlement_amount, pending_released_amount, seller_discount_coupon, downloadable_coupon, seller_service_fee, store_fee_discount, debt_of_last_week, bank_account_holder, bank_name, bank_account, status, input_date, upd_date ) VALUES ( #{shopType}, #{shopId}, IFNULL(#{subStore}, ' '), #{settlementType}, #{settlementDate}, #{totalSale}, #{serviceFee}, #{settlementTargetAmount}, #{settlementAmount}, #{pendingReleasedAmount}, #{sellerDiscountCoupon}, #{downloadableCoupon}, #{sellerServiceFee}, #{storeFeeDiscount}, #{debtOfLastWeek}, #{bankAccountHolder}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{status}, #{inputDate}, #{updDate} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_sale = IFNULL(#{totalSale}, total_sale), service_fee = IFNULL(#{serviceFee}, service_fee), settlement_target_amount = IFNULL(#{settlementTargetAmount}, settlement_target_amount), settlement_amount = IFNULL(#{settlementAmount}, settlement_amount), pending_released_amount = IFNULL(#{pendingReleasedAmount}, pending_released_amount), seller_discount_coupon = IFNULL(#{sellerDiscountCoupon}, seller_discount_coupon), downloadable_coupon = IFNULL(#{downloadableCoupon}, downloadable_coupon), seller_service_fee = IFNULL(#{sellerServiceFee}, seller_service_fee), store_fee_discount = IFNULL(#{storeFeeDiscount}, store_fee_discount), debt_of_last_week = IFNULL(#{debtOfLastWeek}, debt_of_last_week), bank_account_holder = IFNULL(#{bankAccountHolder}, bank_account_holder), bank_name = IFNULL(#{bankName}, bank_name), bank_account = IFNULL(#{bankAccount}, bank_account), status = IFNULL(#{status}, status), upd_date = IFNULL(#{updDate}, NOW())
